atoms.text: Harriet loves spending time in her father’s vegetable garden. Her dad has all sorts of plants. He grows cucumbers, tomatoes, broccoli, cabbages and squash. Harriet is always looking for the next ripe vegetable.
atoms.sound: ssml:Harriet loves spending time in her father’s vegetable garden. <break time='600ms'/>Her dad has all sorts of plants. <break time='600ms'/>He grows cucumbers, tomatoes, broccoli, cabbages and squash. <break time='600ms'/>Harriet is always looking for the next ripe vegetable.

atoms.text:
“Dad! I think this one is ready for picking,” says Harriet looking at a head of cabbage.

“Well, hold on just one minute, let me take a peek,” says her dad.

Her dad comes over and begins to closely examine the head of cabbage that Harriet is pointing to.

“It is so nice to teach you how to garden,” Harriet’s dad says. Harriet grins.

atoms.text:
“Harriet, lightly squeeze the cabbage all around and tell me what you feel,” he says.

“It feels a little bit soft and squishy,” says Harriet.

“Exactly. When a cabbage is ripe, it will be firm all the way around. Let’s give it another week, and then we can check again.”

Harriet starts feeling all the other cabbages — maybe she’ll find a ripe one!
